english.note: Use 搞唔明 when a subject or idea is beyond someone's understanding.

exampleSentences.english: This problem just continues to elude me.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢條數我搞極都搞唔明。

english.note: Use this when someone cannot understand or figure out a complicated matter.

exampleSentences.english: I can't puzzle out this problem.
